edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source account whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping owner slot in approve.
msg.sender is used as spender when decrementing the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval callback.
owner is initialized from the caller address msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender is compared against owner by the onlyOwner guard used by transferOwnership.
msg.sender is compared against newOwner to authorize acceptOwnership.
onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner) gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner) gates execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) gates execution of acceptOwnership.
safeAdd performs the unchecked-at-machine-level addition a + b.
safeSub performs the subtraction a - b guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the multiplication a * b guarded by a division check.
safeDiv performs the division a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
approveAndCall executes the external receiveApproval call after writing the allowance.
The spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall through the receiveApproval callback.
approveAndCall dispatches to the ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval external function.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external transfer call on an arbitrary token contract.
The foreign token contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token during the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token calls ERC20Interface.transfer on the supplied token address.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Constructor sets symbol = VETE.
Constructor sets name = The Patriot Coin.
Constructor sets decimals = 0.
Constructor sets _totalSupply = 800000000.
Constructor credits the full supply to the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts the balances[address(0)] burned amount.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer writes both the sender and recipient balance slots in balances.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom rewrites the from and to balance slots in balances.
transferFrom decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance slot.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before performing the external call.
